Introduction
Dexterous manipulation requires controlling how contacts change during an
operation. Moving a mouse must not trigger a premature click; setting two
knobs requires both knobs to remain at their target settings simultaneously;
and placing a lid requires preserving alignment while releasing it. Evaluating
these capabilities requires demonstrations of varied interactions and diagnostics
that distinguish initial progress from reliable functional completion.
Recent dexterous benchmarks broaden task and embodiment coverage

Discussion and Conclusion
HandsOn provides a common experimental basis for studying the scope and limits of manipulation competence. By treating embodiment, environment, and task structure as configurable experimental variables, it enables systematic investigation of how policy behavior changes across conditions and where generalization breaks down.
Our trained-policy evaluation spans more than 40,000 Core-50 episodes and includes eight multi-task checkpoints, revealing substantial differences in performance across task categories. Pooled across those eight checkpoints, success rates reach 35–51% for pushing, articulation, and pick-and-place, but remain at 2–3% for tool use and precision fitting. These disparities persist after accounting for demonstration count and expert demonstration duration. All tasks in both suites have been successfully demonstrated by human operators, making even the hardest cases concrete, achievable targets for policy improvement.
A prompted GPT-6 controller using
move_eef
succeeds in 29 of 660 trials: 5.2% on Core-50 and 1.9% on Transfer-16. Its saved action notes provide qualitative signs of task-aware sequencing and execution monitoring without benchmark demonstrations or finetuning, suggesting potential as a high-level planner. Reliable execution remains difficult: the minimal harness requires the same model to translate subgoals into palm poses and up to 40 finger-joint targets with limited geometric and contact feedback. This motivates richer agent interfaces that connect high-level planning to state estimation and feedback-driven manipulation skills. The high dimensionality and contact sensitivity of dexterous tasks make this interface a substantive design problem. Matched harness ablations are needed to quantify the contribution of these components.
The diagnostic results point to a common requirement: policies must regulate the state of an interaction throughout execution. They need to distinguish contacts that stabilize an object from those that actuate it, condition release on whether the partner’s hand has secured the object, and maintain achieved goals as the task progresses. Failures on composed tasks further highlight the importance of tracking completed steps and satisfying prerequisites before advancing. Together, these findings motivate learning methods that explicitly account for contact roles, inter-hand dependencies, and task progress.
Future evaluations should measure both task completion and maintenance of success conditions, testing whether control improvements transfer across embodiments and to physical robots. Promising directions include evaluating VLM planners with richer agent harnesses, expanding embodiment and compositional-task coverage, strengthening paired simulation and real-world evaluation, and modeling contact state, inter-hand coordination, and task progress.

article.headline: 灵巧操作仿真基准 HandsOn 发布
article.lede: 含5臂6手、约200个资产、1.8万条演示的66任务仿真基准；最佳多任务策略Core-50成功率29.1%。
article.problem: 灵巧操作要求在整个执行过程中控制接触状态的变化，例如移动鼠标时不能提前触发点击，拧两个旋钮时要同时让两者保持目标位置。现有灵巧操作基准虽在任务与本体覆盖上有所扩展，但人类演示规模小，且很少保留专门用于评测的任务。因此，缺少一个能同时考察跨本体、跨物体泛化与可靠执行完成度的共享实验基础。
article.method: 作者构建了 HandsOn 可组合仿真平台，支持5种机械臂、6种灵巧手和约200个刚体、铰接体与可变形资产，并在随机化场景中评测。基准包含18,000条筛选后的人类演示（约56小时、三路同步视角），以及66个经人工核验的任务：Core-50 用于基于演示的学习与执行测试，Transfer-16 则在不提供目标任务训练演示的情况下考察资产与关系迁移、技能组合和可变形物体操作。评测覆盖单任务 DP、五个 VLA 模型、三个 WAM 模型，以及以提示方式驱动的 GPT-6 控制器。
article.results: 在 Core-50 上，训练过的最佳多任务策略成功率为29.1%；八万多任务检查点合计评测超过40,000个 Core-50 episode（训练策略总计45,000个 episode）。按八检查点汇总，推、铰接操作和抓放的成功率在35%到51%之间，而工具使用与精密装配仅为2%到3%。在 Transfer-16 上，按有序进度排名，OpenWAM 的12.9%分别比 HY-Embodied、LingBot-VLA 和 Spatial Forcing 高6.0、3.7和2.6个百分点。未经基准微调的 GPT-6 使用 move_eef 控制手掌与手指，在660次试验中仅成功29次，Core-50 为5.2%、Transfer-16 为1.9%。演示数量约为代表性灵巧操作基准人类轨迹数的5.7到16.4倍。
article.why_it_matters: 该基准将本体、环境与任务结构当作可配置的实验变量，为比较不同策略在何处失效提供了统一的对照基础。其诊断显示，失败集中在建立接触、协调动作和维持已达成的目标；这提示需要显式建模接触角色、双手依赖与任务进度的方法。
article.limitations: 真实机器人迁移只给出了定性演示视频，论文未给出量化的 sim-to-real 数字。并且 GPT-6 是输入与调用预算都不同的提示式参考，不能与训练策略直接比较；DP 也仅是描述性参考，其目标分布并未对齐。作者还指出，需要做匹配的 harness 消融实验，才能量化各组件（高层规划、状态估计与反馈技能）的贡献。
article.figure_caption_zh: 人类演示采集流程：手套记录手指关节运动，腕部追踪器记录手部轨迹；重定向后的指令驱动机器人仿真臂手系统，同时操作者观察场景。

journals.title: Towards understanding and monitorability of reasoning LLMs
journals.summary:
Nature Machine Intelligence, Published online: 19 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s42256-026-01333-6

Frontier LLMs are trained to solve problems in a step-by-step way, generating reasoning text in human-understandable language. However, these reasoning tokens are not accurate explanations of LLMs’ internal computations, raising challenges for monitorability.
journals.blurb: 前沿大模型被训练为以逐步方式解题，并用人类可理解的自然语言生成推理文本。但摘要指出，这些推理 token 并非对模型内部计算的准确解释，这给可监控性带来了挑战。该文因此聚焦于对推理型大模型的理解与监控问题。

journals.title: Bundle water safeguards into critical-mineral licences
journals.summary:
Nature, Published online: 20 October 2026; doi:10.1038/d41586-026-03353-z

Bundle water safeguards into critical-mineral licences
journals.blurb: 《Nature》刊文呼吁将水资源保护措施捆绑进关键矿物许可审批。对依赖关键矿物的机器学习硬件供应链而言，这意味着资源治理与采购风险需要一并纳入考量。文章强调，关键矿物开发许可不应只关注矿产供给，还应同步设置水保障要求。
